Generate legal moves

Source: R/movegen.R
gm_legal_moves.Rd

Enumerate every legal move in a position, accounting for checks, pins, castling, en passant and promotion.

Usage

gm_legal_moves(position)

Arguments

position

A gm_position object.

Value

A tibble::tibble() with one row per legal move and columns: from (character square, e.g. "e2"), to (character square), piece (character), san (character, standard algebraic notation), promotion (character or NA), flag (character: "normal", "capture", "castle", "ep", "promo"). Zero rows in checkmate or stalemate.

See also

Other core: gm_game, gm_move(), gm_position(), gm_status(), is_gm_game(), is_gm_position()

Examples

gm_legal_moves(gm_position())
